This small plot near my home I use for one of our other crops — not teff or maize like the bigger fields. For this kind of crop I don't usually buy fertilizer from the cooperative; the cost is too much and the plant responds better to the manure I carry from our animals. I will use seed I saved myself, as I always have, and I will work the plot with my own hands and with help from my children. I don't have money for pesticide or for hiring people on such a small piece of land.
